notes.title: Settlement UI
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Stewards![/p][p][/p][p]Time to peek under the hood of your settlements. We are starting with the two tabs you will be using all the time: Needs and Buildings.[/p][p][/p][p]The Needs tab shows what meals and equipment are available in the settlement. Each meal increases building efficiency, but only if all required ingredients are present. Equipment increases the maximum number of employed villagers and unlocks additional building slots. Each of the four social classes in the game has its own unique progressively more complex recipes and equipment.[/p][p][/p][p]The Buildings tab provides a full overview of constructed buildings. In addition to the key metrics of efficiency and employment, it also shows maintenance status and what each building actually does.[/p][p][/p][p]These screenshots also reveal a few other features we have not talked about yet. We will leave those for another time, but feel free to guess in the comments :)[/p][p][/p][p][i]And as always: County of Fortune is still in development. Everything shown is a work in progress and subject to change. notes.title: Trading Sneak Peek
notes.content:
Greetings, Stewards!

It’s been a while since our last update on County of Fortune, but rest assured — development is in full swing!

Today, we’re excited to share a sneak peek at the trading system. While we’ll dive deeper into trade in future posts, this preview focuses on something close to our hearts: showcasing your entire county in all its beauty. After all, you’re not managing just a single city — you’re shaping an entire county. And that deserves to be seen.

Also… we love maps. You love maps. [i]Everyone[/i] loves maps!

And even though this is just a glimpse, we’ve chosen these screenshots carefully — look closely and you might spot hints about other features or the trade itself. 

Let us know what you think in the comments — and see you soon!

[i]And as always: County of Fortune is still in development. Everything shown is a work in progress and subject to change. [/i]

notes.title: New Terrain and Vegetation
notes.content:
Greetings, Stewards!

And a very warm welcome to our first County of Fortune update! We just wanted to say a big, heartfelt thank you for the amazing welcome you've given us to our new game! We were so happy to see how many of you loved our idea!

While I've been working on new features for the last few weeks, the other half of the studio has been preparing a major rework of the terrain visuals and completely new vegetation.

Now that the rework is done, we'd love to share it with you! What do you think? Let us know in the comments!
